skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of environmental planning
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the essence of environmental planning, its position in development planning, and the role of environmental planning.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Position of Environmental Planning in Resource Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of environmental planning in resource management.
Apply processes and methods for environmental planning, evaluate options, and choose optimal solutions for environmental planning.
Use various methods to evaluate environmental plans and assess the environmental aspects of integrated plans.
Develop independent work skills, self-study abilities, and creativity.
Possess teamwork skills, self-management, and responsibility.
